utm_east.definition: Easting in metres in the UTM zone identified by the producer tile filename.

utm_north.definition: Northing in metres in the UTM zone identified by the producer tile filename.

width_m.definition: Observed wetted river width, in metres. The value 1 is the producer missing-width code; use width_valid when filtering.

segmentID.definition: Producer segment identifier, unique within its source tile only.

segmentInd.definition: Observation index within a segment; it does not specify upstream-to-downstream ordering.

lakeFlag.definition: Producer class: 0 river, 1 lake or reservoir, 2 tidal river, 3 canal.

elev_m.definition: Elevation in metres sampled by the producer from Hydro1k.

source_tile.definition: Original producer shapefile tile stem, retained by the converter.

source_row.definition: Original 1-based shapefile record ordinal within source_tile; retained by the converter.

feature_id.definition: Converter identifier combining tile identity in the high 32 bits with source_row in the low 32 bits; globally unique in this release.

width_valid.definition: Converter flag: width_m is non-null, positive and different from the producer missing-width sentinel 1.

bbox.definition: Converter bounding box in WGS84 longitude/latitude degrees: xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax. It supports spatial filtering without changing source geometry.

geometry.definition: WKB MultiLineString in WGS84 longitude/latitude (OGC:CRS84); source record parts, vertex order and XY values are preserved.
